paragraph: A high school teacher in Sandy Springs, Georgia, was driving to work with her husband earlier this month. They were on their way to pick up birthday cupcakes for her journalism students. The couple also had a Halloween wedding anniversary to celebrate. A tiny black cat had climbed inside their car engine and needed rescue. The unexpected discovery brought the couple joy right in time for their anniversary.
